parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or a Security Token Service (STS) temporary credential for authentication.

parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: The unique ID of the organization. You can find this ID in your browser's URL after logging in to the Alibaba Cloud DevOps platform: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}.
